decisions.reason: The cover's hero placement and headline integration are owned by the separate book-cover Requirement and do not invalidate any current hero-copy or section-placement attribute.
Book-cover placement in the hero does not change the approved FAQ content; the same message's FAQ revisions are separate decisions already represented in this candidate.
The landing-page book-cover presentation does not alter any About-page content or resolve its reward-delivery ambiguity.
The source decision concerns the landing-page cover and hero, not the Mission page or its copy.
Integrating the book cover with the hero headline does not change the current or conditional future project names.
The cover's visual placement does not change Mauritius access restrictions for the landing page.
The book-cover presentation does not change the next-draw sales counter; that counter is established by a separate clause in the same message.
Moving the book cover into the hero and integrating it with the headline does not modify the $15 mint price or price commitment.
The landing-page cover presentation does not affect the mint-number referral-code identity or any of its display locations.
Displaying the book cover in the landing-page hero does not change optional PDF download availability, labeling, or presentation.
The cover and headline integration does not change the deferred Transak fiat-mint behavior or provider configuration.
The book-cover presentation does not change fiat buyers' wallet, dashboard, commission, ticket, prize, or email access behavior.
